features: Adds a continuously refreshing Competitor Scoring Matrix to Live Automated Scoring and the Test Automated Simulator
Heats matrix shows every competitor against every judge with YES, A1, A2, A3 or blank plus the current accumulated weighted score
Live Heats rows auto-sort provisionally from highest current score to lowest while judges are scoring
Adds manual sort controls for Score High to Low, Score Low to High, Bib Number, Name and Original Order
Adds an Auto Sort control so administrators can freeze row order while live scores continue updating
Judge Progress and Competitor Scoring Progress update independently through no-cache polling
Final matrix shows each confirmed couple and the rank entered by every judge; official Final ordering remains dependent on Relative Placement rather than raw rank totals
Adds Admin Reopen control for submitted Live Automated judge sessions with a mandatory reason while preserving existing marks for correction and resubmission
Test Automated Scoring receives the same live competitor matrix and sorting behavior while retaining one-click judge score generation
Live scoring remains read-only from the Admin matrix; only judges enter marks through their secure judge links
